rows.invalid_behavior_enabled: Sentence evidence may license an incompatible event or concept claim.

rows.invalid_behavior_enabled: Evidence for a->b may license b->a.
rows.contribution_consequence: Directional authorization transfers to an unevidenced pair.

rows.invalid_behavior_enabled: A negative annotation may be read as positive support or reverse truth.
rows.contribution_consequence: Construct conflict becomes an admitted semantic relation.

rows.invalid_behavior_enabled: A fallback may lose lineage while remaining emit-able.
rows.contribution_consequence: The downgraded representation is no longer auditable to its evidence.

rows.invalid_behavior_enabled: A refused semantic claim may silently collapse to lexical association.
rows.contribution_consequence: Refusal no longer controls the representation reached by downgrade.

rows.invalid_behavior_enabled: A visibly refused claim may leak into a downstream artifact.
rows.contribution_consequence: Statement and mark governance can be bypassed through export.

rows.invalid_behavior_enabled: Metadata-complete causal evidence may be promoted without approval.
rows.contribution_consequence: An authored governance gate disappears while the claim still admits.

architecture_enforcement_ablation.scope: Generated mechanism probes compare output reachability in four output-control conditions over three fixtures. Unauthorized means not authorized under Policy 2.7.0 for the supplied claim/evidence fixture. Reachable means emitted, selectable, renderable, or exportable as an output under the condition; a fallback merely listed in certificate metadata is excluded. A separate suite audits eight maintained certificate-guarded output entry points; no fixture-by-path cross-product is claimed. These probes do not characterize all warning or inspection systems or establish human benefit, safety effectiveness, formal noninterference, or universal non-bypassability.

evidence_integrity_trust_boundary.source_text: Source fixture relation: event B precedes event A.
evidence_integrity_trust_boundary.scope: Policy conformance checks the supplied typed record, not whether its source text is semantically correct or authentic. Authorization therefore remains conditional on upstream evidence integrity.

complete_mediation.invariant: Every maintained certificate-guarded output entry point consumes a valid selected certificate or complete certificate collection.
